title: Bright-end archive test: missing data versus missed data
short_title: An apparent archival gap has two explanations
tts_instructions: Measured scientific-conference narration in Alloy. Calm, precise, and authoritative. Preserve both Boylan-Kolchin abstract sentences verbatim. Voice them as attributed reports from another study, never as this video’s findings. Emphasize that the source itself leaves the observational-property explanation unresolved. Keep the field contested. Do not imply that an excess, archival gap, catalogue count, object count, or explanation has been established by this video.

sentences.text: A published bright-end summary can lack a reconstructible object record because the data are missing, or because the search missed them.

sentences.text: Early data from JWST have revealed a bevy of high-redshift galaxy candidates with unexpectedly high stellar masses.

the most massive galaxy candidates in JWST observations at z∼7-10 lie at the very edge of these limits, indicating an important unresolved issue with the properties of galaxies derived from the observations, how galaxies form at early times in ΛCDM, or within this standard cosmology itself.
Boylan-Kolchin reported these claims and left the issue unresolved; the field remains contested, and this video adopts neither claim nor explanation as its finding.
sentences.display_citation: Lana lane ruling · source supplies the separation · no winner

params.heading: WHAT THE LITERATURE BEAT DOES NOT DECIDE

sentences.text: Counting catalogues cannot settle that question, because a useful object record needs rest-ultraviolet magnitude and redshift in the same eligible table.

params.heading: WHY A CATALOGUE COUNT CANNOT SETTLE IT
params.left: REST-UV MAGNITUDE AND REDSHIFT IN ONE TABLE
params.right: A NAME OR TAG WITHOUT A USABLE OBJECT PAIR
params.bottom: REACHABILITY ALONE DOES NOT CREATE AN EVIDENCE PLANE

sentences.text: Even a same-table pair can fail if the band convention, object class, completeness record, or provenance does not support the frozen frame.

params.heading: THE AMBIGUITY CONTINUES AFTER RETRIEVAL
params.left: FRAME, OBJECT CLASS, AND PROVENANCE AGREE
params.right: WRONG BAND, WRONG OBJECT, OR UNKNOWN CHAIN

sentences.text: The discriminating move begins with two independent retrieval channels: physical metadata descriptors and exhaustive, case-aware name patterns.

params.heading: THE DISCRIMINANT: TWO CHANNELS INTO ONE PLANE
params.display_form: empty evidence plane with symbolic boundaries and provenance flow outside axes

sentences.text: Their union enters a fail-closed eligibility layer that reads the public table description before any science row is allowed through.

params.heading: UNION THE CHANNELS, THEN ADJUDICATE
params.display_form: empty evidence plane with symbolic boundaries and provenance flow outside axes

sentences.text: Only records with a defensible magnitude convention and a usable redshift are projected into the same magnitude-redshift evidence plane.

params.heading: PROJECT ONLY CONTRACT-GRADE RECORDS
params.same_table: SAME OBJECT · SAME TABLE · RECORDED FRAME
params.display_form: empty evidence plane with symbolic boundaries and provenance flow outside axes

sentences.text: A visible bright threshold and slice boundary are applied there, while completeness and contamination labels remain attached to every contributing record.

params.heading: APPLY THE BOUNDARIES WITHOUT DROPPING PROVENANCE
params.display_form: empty evidence plane with symbolic boundaries and provenance flow outside axes

sentences.text: That evidence plane distinguishes data that are absent from data that were merely invisible to one retrieval instrument, without showing either outcome here.

params.heading: THE EVIDENCE PLANE EARNS THE DISTINCTION
params.display_form: empty evidence plane with symbolic boundaries and provenance flow outside axes

sentences.text: The source ledger preserves discovery, eligibility, object-level projection, and slice accounting as changing units, with every result count removed from this canary.
sentences.display_citation: Archive workflow · result counts not displayed

params.heading: KEEP THE UNIT ATTACHED TO EACH STAGE

sentences.text: Because no sibling source freeze exists, the method retains the stage labels but drops catalogue totals, row totals, and bright-end counts.

params.heading: DROP UNSAFE VALUES, KEEP THE PIPELINE
params.banner: NO SOURCE FREEZE · NO NUMBER CARD

sentences.text: The estimator is a raw slice count of eligible objects brighter than the frozen threshold, written symbolically and left unevaluated.

params.heading: BUILD THE ESTIMATOR WITHOUT REVEALING IT
params.expression: sum I(M_UV < M_cut, z in slice)

sentences.text: Completeness correction, cross-catalog merging, and pace inference remain separate gates; the raw count cannot silently become any of them.

params.heading: THE ESTIMATOR CANNOT CHANGE ITS CLAIM

sentences.text: The metadata-versus-name control tests query blindness, while the same-table rule tests accidental joins between unrelated columns.
sentences.display_citation: Retrieval and join controls · design only

sentences.text: Object class, band convention, completeness, and provenance controls prevent a visually plausible point from becoming an unsupported bright-end record.

params.heading: A POINT NEEDS AN AUDIT TRAIL

sentences.text: We tied our own hands by freezing the frame, thresholds, slices, and eligibility clauses before fetching any object rows.

params.bottom: THE FRAME CANNOT MOVE AFTER THE OBJECTS ARE SEEN

sentences.text: The gates are scientific discipline: missing metadata stays missing, and no inferred convention can be chosen later to rescue a record.
What is known is the retrieval and eligibility design; catalogue totals, object counts, an archival gap, and any luminosity-function pace remain outside this canary.
Ask the opening question again: are object records genuinely absent, or were they invisible to the retrieval instrument?
Now we have a method that can tell those explanations apart without manufacturing a catalogue count or an archival result.

params.heading: THE METHOD EARNS THE ANSWER
